title: Shipping and delivery
content: Standard shipping usually takes 3 to 7 business days after dispatch. Tracking estimates can change due to carrier delays. Use the order status tool for a specific demo order.

title: Returns and refunds
content: For this demo, refund eligibility can be checked only after an order is marked delivered. Eligible requests are submitted for review within 30 days. The demo agent never issues a real refund.

title: Order cancellation
content: Orders that are still processing may be eligible for cancellation review. Shipped or delivered orders cannot be cancelled through this demo. Contact support for a real order.

title: Privacy and account security
content: Never share passwords, one-time passcodes, or full payment card details in support chat. This demo uses synthetic order data and does not connect to customer accounts.

title: Product warranty
content: Warranty coverage depends on the product and purchase terms. This demo knowledge base does not contain product-specific warranty durations, so support should confirm the product documentation.
